title: Comment on “On the pass‐through rate of the Nutrition North Canada subsidy”
title_zh: 对“加拿大北方营养补贴传导率”一文的评论
abstract: Naylor, Deaton and Ker provide estimates of Nutrition North Canada subsidy pass‐through using data we collected and an identification strategy we devised. They propose an alternative econometric specification based on estimating passthrough for separate monopoly and non‐monopoly sub‐samples and aggregating the coefficients using subsidy share weights. They argue that this specification is more appropriate for estimating overall subsidy pass‐through and conclude that its application to our data provides evidence for full subsidy pass‐through. We show that their conclusions are not warranted by making two distinct but related points. First, we show that conclusions based on their specification are not robust to two changes in the estimating sample. Correcting two subsidy assignment and one monopoly classification error in the original data set, or using a time period more relevant for comparing heterogeneous effects across monopoly and non‐monopoly communities, leads to estimates that either reinforce our original finding of incomplete passthrough or that are too imprecise to be informative. Second, we provide a graphical illustration and power calculation to make a more general point about the appropriateness and limitations of the type of sub‐sample analysis they propose in settings with limited sample size and statistical power.
abstract_zh: Naylor、Deaton和Ker利用我们收集的数据及我们设计的识别策略，估算了“营养北方加拿大”补贴的传导效应。他们提出了一种替代性计量模型，基于对垄断与非垄断子样本分别估算传导效应，并通过补贴份额权重对系数进行加总。他们认为该模型更适合估算整体补贴传导效应，并据此得出结论：将该模型应用于我们的数据可证明补贴完全传导。我们通过两个独立但相关的论点表明，其结论缺乏依据。第一，我们证明其模型结论对估算样本的两项调整缺乏稳健性。修正原始数据集中的两项补贴分配错误和一项垄断分类错误，或采用更适用于比较垄断与非垄断社区异质性效应的时段，所得估算结果要么强化了我们最初关于不完全传导的发现，要么因精度过低而无法提供有效信息。第二，我们通过图形说明和统计功效计算，就其在样本量有限且统计功效不足的背景下所提出的子样本分析方法的适用性与局限性，提出更一般性的观点。

title: Double Robustness of Local Projections and Some Unpleasant VARithmetic
title_zh: 局部投影的双重稳健性与一些令人不快的VAR算术
authors: José Luis Montiel Olea, Mikkel Plagborg-Møller, Eric Qian, Christian K. Wolf
abstract: We consider impulse response inference in a locally misspecified vector autoregression (VAR) model. The conventional local projection (LP) confidence interval has correct coverage even when the misspecification is so large that it can be detected with probability approaching 1. This result follows from a “double robustness” property analogous to that of popular partially linear regression estimators. By contrast, the conventional VAR confidence interval with short‐to‐moderate lag length can severely undercover for misspecification that is small, difficult to detect statistically, and cannot be ruled out based on economic theory. The VAR confidence interval has robust coverage if, and only if, the lag length is so large that the interval is as wide as the LP interval.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在局部误设定的向量自回归（VAR）模型中脉冲响应推断的问题。传统的局部投影（LP）置信区间即使在误设定程度大到能以趋近于1的概率被检测到时，仍能保持正确的覆盖率。这一结果源于一种与流行的部分线性回归估计量相似的“双重稳健性”性质。相比之下，采用短至中等滞后长度的传统VAR置信区间，在面对较小、难以从统计上检测且无法基于经济理论排除的误设定时，可能严重低估覆盖率。VAR置信区间只有在滞后长度足够大，使其区间宽度与LP区间相当时，才具有稳健的覆盖率。

title: Central Bank Digital Currency with Collateral‐Constrained Banks
title_zh: 抵押约束银行下的央行数字货币
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract: We analyze risks to bank intermediation following the introduction of a central bank digital currency (CBDC) competing with commercial bank deposits as households' source of liquidity. We revisit the equivalence of payment systems result, introducing a collateral constraint on banks' borrowing from the central bank. Comparing equilibria with and without CBDC, we find that the central bank can ensure the same equilibrium allocation by offering loans to banks. However, to access loans, banks must hold collateral at the expense of extending credit to firms. While CBDC introduction has no real effects, it changes aggregate capital ownership and banks' business models.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了央行数字货币（CBDC）引入后对银行中介业务的风险，该数字货币与商业银行存款作为家庭流动性来源形成竞争。我们重新审视了支付系统等价性结论，引入了银行从央行借款的抵押约束。通过比较引入CBDC与未引入CBDC的均衡状态，我们发现央行可以通过向银行提供贷款来确保相同的均衡配置。然而，为获得贷款，银行必须以牺牲向企业发放信贷为代价持有抵押品。尽管CBDC的引入没有实际影响，但它改变了总体资本所有权和银行的商业模式。
